name: Lean On It
hint: A ring on a button is a timer. Keep touching it and it stays on.
why4: Three must push the 3-block through the gate while a fourth leans on the far button; with three, the presser cannot reach the block before the 2-second timer runs out.
solution: P4, P3, P2 push the 3-block right (P4 against it at x=19, P3, P2 behind) until it rests against gate A (block at x=24-25).
P1 walks left and leans on the button at x=1 (2-second timer, restarted while touched): gate A at x=26 opens.
P4, P3, P2 push the block through the gate and on to the plateau wall (block ends at x=34-35).
P2 stands under the inner button at x=27 (on the gate's right side, 3 high; 1-second timer) and keeps jumping into it; P1 runs right through the gate (about 4.5 s).
Everyone climbs: floor -> block top (2) -> plateau (2 more).
P4 touches the key at x=42; everyone jumps the 2-wide pit at x=46-47; P4 opens the door at x=52; all press Down.
